answer.explanation: TicketController in the presentation layer imports and is constructor-injected with TicketRepository from the persistence layer. It calls repo.close() directly, so it skips the business layer (TicketService). FF-S03 flags this because presentation should reach persistence only through the business layer. A comment on close() states an architecture decision that grants this case on purpose: close() may write through TicketRepository directly because closing has no business rule. The grant covers the close() write path. open() still goes through TicketService.

citation.quote: // Architecture decision: close() may write through TicketRepository directly; closing has no business rule.

exceptionClaim.scope: TicketController.close() may write directly through TicketRepository, bypassing the business layer, because closing has no business rule.
